source_claim: SNK's official Ryuuko no Ken / Art of Fighting collection page covers the original game and Art of Fighting Gaiden. The original-game section names Ryo Sakazaki and Robert Garcia and describes Yuri Sakazaki as a character in the kidnapping story; the Gaiden character directory explicitly lists Kasumi Todoh. All four are direct characters of the Art of Fighting copyright series.
notes: The source is SNK's own compilation of the Art of Fighting / Ryuuko no Ken titles; member evidence is explicitly named across its first-game story and Gaiden character directory.
